name: Lion King Yeet
look: A small, blurry animated still from The Lion King: the baboon Rafiki stands on the tip of Pride Rock against a blue sky with streaky clouds, leaning back with baby Simba lifted in his arms as if winding up to hurl him off the cliff.
use: Parodies the famous scene where Rafiki presents baby Simba to the kingdom, except he throws the cub off the cliff. Simba is labeled as something being gleefully thrown away, with a caption for who is doing the throwing.
slots: top caption: who is throwing (Rafiki) or the situation
label for Simba: the thing being thrown away
examples: Me on the first warm day of spring
describe: rafiki throwing baby simba off pride rock
lion king monkey tosses the cub off the cliff
baboon hurling a lion cub into the sky
lion king presentation scene but he throws the baby away
cartoon monkey on a rock holding up a baby lion
origin: An edit of the presentation scene from Disney's The Lion King (1994) in which Rafiki throws Simba instead of holding him up.
